shadows.name: panel-lift

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The emerald CTA — primary action on every screen; carries the accent glow in the navbar.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>Add Ticket</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #10b981; color: #fff; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(167,243,208,0.5); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #059669; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #10b981; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost/bordered action for non-primary tasks (Créer un ticket, Corriger).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); color: #4b5563; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f9fafb; } .ds-btn-secondary__badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #f3f4f6; color: #6b7280; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Rounded status badge with a bg-current leading dot; color maps to business status. Shown here as Canonique (emerald).
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; background: #ecfdf5; color: #059669; border: 1px solid #a7f3d0; } .ds-pill__dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: The signature frosted-glass surface — every content container. Translucent white + backdrop blur, never opaque.
components.html:
Informations

Frosted glass floats over the aurora; the atmosphere stays faintly visible through the surface.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px); border: 1px solid rgba(229,231,235,0.7); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(17,24,39,0.05); padding: 24px; } .ds-panel__eyebrow { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6b7280; } .ds-panel__body { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; color: #4b5563; }

components.description: Standard field with the universal emerald focus ring; select and textarea share this vocabulary.

narrative.overview: TicketAI is a human-in-the-loop workspace where validators review AI-drafted helpdesk answers before they ship. The identity is carried by a single living element: an animated WebGL aurora (emerald simplex-noise) fixed behind the entire app. Everything else — sidebar, topbar, every content panel — is a sheet of frosted glass laid over that aurora, letting emerald light bleed up from beneath. The aurora is the brand; the glass is the desk. Emerald is the one true accent — primary actions, current nav, canonical answers, the aurora itself — and appears nowhere as decoration. Neutrals do the heavy lifting; dark mode is a first-class near-black night palette. The system rejects the flat opaque-card SaaS dashboard: surfaces are translucent, blurred, and border-defined, so the atmosphere behind them is always faintly present.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (emerald), one atmosphere (aurora), one surface material (frosted glass).
Fixed rem type scale, single system-sans family, tight hierarchy.
Translucency + backdrop-blur instead of heavy shadows for depth.
Class-toggled dark mode with a near-black night palette; no FOUC.
Standardized semantic state colors mapped to business statuses.

rules.name: The One Emerald Rule
rules.body: Emerald is reserved for primary action, current selection, canonical/success state, and the aurora. It is never a decorative fill, gradient, or background band.

rules.name: The Translucent Surface Rule
rules.body: No content surface is solid #ffffff. Every panel is white/80 + backdrop-blur-xl; every dark surface is white/5. The aurora must always be faintly readable behind the chrome.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: Type sizes are fixed rem steps, never clamp/fluid. Headings that shrink in a collapsed sidebar look broken, not responsive.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Color Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is created with weight (500/600) and the gray ramp, not with the accent. Text is almost never emerald.

rules.name: The Frosted-Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is backdrop-blur-xl + translucency, never a dark shadow. If a surface needs to feel lifted, increase blur or opacity contrast — do not reach for shadow-lg.

dos: Do keep emerald to the four sanctioned roles (primary action, current selection, canonical/success, aurora).
Do render every content surface as frosted glass: white/80 + backdrop-blur-xl + border-gray-200/70 + shadow-sm.
Do use the emerald focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500) on every interactive control.
Do map status to the standardized semantic triad (emerald / blue / yellow / red) with a light and a /10 dark variant.
Do use fixed rem type sizes and the single system-sans family; create hierarchy with weight and the gray ramp.
Do provide light and dark variants for every color — dark mode is first-class, not an afterthought.
Do keep transitions to transition-colors (~150-250ms); reserve the duration-300 choreography for the sidebar collapse only.
donts: Don't ship a solid opaque #ffffff card with a hard drop shadow — frosted glass only.
Don't reach for shadow-lg/deep shadows for depth; use backdrop-blur + translucency.
Don't use emerald as a decorative fill, gradient text, or background band. No background-clip: text gradients.
Don't use border-left/border-right colored side-stripes on panels, alerts, or list items; use the full border + bg-current dot pattern.
Don't introduce a second font family or a display face for UI labels, buttons, or data.
Don't use clamp/fluid type in the app UI; headings stay at fixed rem steps.
Don't invent new status colors or one-off accent hues; extend the existing semantic vocabulary.
